analogy.rationale: Estrogen receptor agonists act through ESR1/ESR2, but these cell lines (melanoma, lung, colon, prostate, etc.) generally express low ER levels, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor ligands that share the steroid hormone receptor downstream program, though they act on different receptors.
